$comment: Hub route metadata (ADR-0004 in multi_channel_design). Ownership model: POLICY (what a channel wants: audience, relevance, editorial routes, source-subscription intent) is owned by the multi_channel_design repo and referenced here as an EXTERNAL canonical policy dependency via `externalPolicy.*`; RUNTIME (what is fetched, how, how often, source health) is owned by THIS repo. `externalPolicy.*` paths are relative to the root of the repo named in `externalPolicyRepo`; they are never treated as global-content-os-owned files. Local resolution of that root is centralized in scripts/architecture-invariants.test.mjs (sibling checkout `../multi_channel_design`, which also holds after grouping under projects/content-systems/). This file has no runtime consumer today; it is validated by the invariants test.
